players.product: Final-test and system-level-test (SLT) handlers with active thermal control for AI / HPC / ASIC chips (GPU, CPU, TPU); CPO / CPC test handlers

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 Q1 results (company deck): gross margin 56.24%, operating profit NT$5,360,051 thousand (50.0%), net income NT$4,624,266 thousand (43.1%). 2026 Q1 order mix: AI / HPC / ASIC (AI computing, server, networking, APU/GPU/CPU/FPGA) 78%, from 72% in 2025; automotive 9% (from 11%); mobile AP / communication 9% (from 10%); 3C consumer 3% (from 5%); memory / MEMS 1% (from 2%).
quarterly_data.figure: AI / HPC / ASIC 78% of 2026 Q1 orders (72% in 2025)

quarterly_data.signal: Key notes, final test and SLT (company deck): growth in a CSP customer's new CPU orders; a U.S. EV major's AI chip ramps up in 3Q26 (dual-temp FT, with adoption by Korea and Taiwan OSATs; tri-temp SLT); large-package ATC handler (new model) shipments scheduled for 3Q26; the Austin customer continues next-gen CPU shipments; an engineering ATC handler was delivered to a U.S. GPU customer in 26Q2; CSP customers' next-gen CPU+TPU spec upgrade to >10KW is in development and validation.
quarterly_data.figure: new large-package ATC handler shipments scheduled for 3Q26

quarterly_data.signal: CPO (company deck): continued demand growth from an Israeli customer's ASIC switch in 2H26; INS4 OE (optical-electrical co-test) is in large-scale engineering data qualification and expected to release in 2H26.

Cold plate (company deck): customers' next-generation products plus installed-base expansion are driving growth in high-end cold plate orders; revenue is recognized upon shipment; the company expects 2026 cold plate revenue contribution to exceed historical average levels.
